findings.finding: Failure hook or failure receipt write exception prevents stop pipe notification and can bypass bounded close. ENOSPC reproduces the relevant write-failure class.
findings.requested_fix: Attempt receipts first, then guarantee cooperative stop notification and bounded drain even if a hook or receipt write fails; preserve diagnostic write error. Add fault injection regression.
findings.resolution: Protected diagnostic writes and hook execution; explicit cooperative notification and bounded teardown remain reachable. Python injected hook/write failure regressions pass.

findings.finding: Failure-record save may throw from the catch body, skipping explicit ordered provider and owner teardown. main.cpp save throws on stream failure.
findings.requested_fix: Protect best-effort failure-record writes and continue explicit owner shutdown; preserve write failure in error and stderr if storage cannot record it.
findings.resolution: Each failure-record save has its own catch; provider reset and engine shutdown follow regardless of record failure. Source-reviewed; parent must rebuild runtime.

cleared_by_inspection: Mailbox payloads published release/acquire; single outstanding remote command prevents concurrent payload overwrite.
FUTEX_WAIT uses shared futex and expected sequence, with EAGAIN/spurious-wake/EINTR handling. No lost wakeup found.
All futex sleeps are at most 10 ms and absolute deadline bounds each wait; no spin phase.
Queued and new commands check external cancellation and mailbox abort before admission.
Native exception publishes abort before propagating. Normal op-0 worker exit is acknowledged before socket completion.
Wrapper polls liveness and deadline; shared mapping is removed only after both process exits.
Stop pipe remains readable for both ranks; they never consume stop byte. Parent death causes pipe HUP.
Suite request reset is outside active native operation after both socket completion replies.
limits: Three mock storage/hook cases passed now; no native binary or prior receipt is certified by this review.
Native C++ catch change requires parent rebuild and ordinary host gates.
Device backend cancellation and owner drain require coordinator device windows.

final_rereview.kind: source-only rereview after request snapshot retention changes
checks: Both RESET socket replies finish before snapshot hashing/deletion or shared mailbox clearing; neither native worker is active.
Snapshot retention only reads completed files and deletes archived target/draft snapshots; eight emitted-token layer fixtures remain intact.
Runtime target buffer hashes are verified against raw snapshot bytes before deletion; metadata and file hashes survive exact gzip roundtrip.
Any retention or disk-admission exception enters protected suite failure path, cooperatively stops both ranks, and waits bounded teardown.
Native mini equivalence now loads archived state metadata and hashes after reset; emitted tokens/guesses/counters remain compared directly.
Window retention starts only after all launched owner PIDs have exited and preserves prerequisite verification via compressed and uncompressed hashes.
final_rereview.dynamic_evidence: Earlier mock storage/window tests are separate receipts. Parent owns actual native and suite runtime reruns; this review does not certify their results.

mini_harness_boundary_rereview.finding: Initial reset prepares case-0. Each request uses current case-N, then one completed reset captures case-N and prepares case-(N+1) before signature reads archive and deletes case-N. Every request retains a complete boundary reset; native mailbox clearing, target/draft resets, and archived signature comparison are unchanged. The unused between request/reset was redundant.
mini_harness_boundary_rereview.dynamic_limit: Interrupted prior run is not a full pass; parent must finish new exhaustive run.

streaming_storage_rereview.kind: source and source-bound receipt verification; no tests rerun
streaming_storage_rereview.scope: archive_files streams bounded chunks, checks retained bytes against input hashes, verifies completed archive before replacement; discard deletes scratch only after verified archive returns. Nested gzip evidence is retained exactly. Existing admit(extra) callers preserve root/build checks; archive-only build_extra=0 still checks current build budget and full root reserve. Runtime/native/suite gate results are not inferred from six synthetic export checks.

storage_scan_race_fix.tests: 3 mock-only checks plus 6 synthetic export/retention checks rerun; no ranks or device
storage_scan_race_fix.change: A single-pass build_size helper ignores only FileNotFoundError from a member disappearing between discovery/type check/stat. Other filesystem errors still propagate. No retry loop, no weakened disk thresholds.

distinct_warmup_rereview.review: Bounded deterministic five-token selection is absent from every contiguous suite span and independent of prompt order. Initial short synthetic request is excluded from measurements and followed by complete request reset. Review found first-token EOS could leave draft head cold; final code suppresses EOS only for keyword-selected excluded warmup and requires both target outputs. Normal measured requests retain their original EOS behavior. Controller/IPC/reset code unchanged.
distinct_warmup_rereview.tests_this_turn: Three mocked ENOSPC/hook cases rerun and passed; no rank or device execution; integrated suite results remain separate.

suite_timing_metadata_rereview.change: Per-request rate numerator, interval endpoints and decode rank occupancy now consistently use non-EOG events. Per-output rank fields added. No token generation, reset, IPC or speculation state transition changes.
